dedupe_keys.name: dubai monthly electricity demand preparation notebook

description: This preparation notebook produces community-level electricity-demand inputs for Dubai by processing Dubai Pulse records and adding external factors. The research collaborators describe stages for accumulating consumption records, adding exogenous variables, preprocessing and assessing feature importance. Mendeley publishes one Jupyter Notebook file, Data_Preprocessing_final.ipynb, under CC BY 4.0 with free access. The associated dataset covers May 2017–December 2019, while the reusable workflow itself does not promise automatic updates or a fixed operational horizon. It prepares model inputs, not documenting an independently maintained electricity simulator. The current metadata do not establish its language kernel, package versions or continued availability of every upstream endpoint. A reviewer-assessed use is reproducing demand-input preparation and testing sensitivity to external factors before energy-system simulation. model-pypsa is a related planning environment, but no native connection is documented. The notebook was not downloaded or executed, and a separate record covers its published data outputs.
